cd /tmp && python3 -c "
import urllib.request, re

# Fetch Survivor page
req = urllib.request.Request('https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Survivor_(American_TV_series)', headers={'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0'})
html = urllib.request.urlopen(req).read().decode('utf-8')

# Find the winners section - look for season table
# Usually winners are listed in infobox or specific tables
# Let's search for 'winner' in the text
lines = html.split('\n')
